description: Send one delivery again: the same event (same id and body, so you can dedupe on id), freshly signed with the key's current webhook secret, to the URL it was first sent to. One attempt, no retries; the response has the outcome and the updated delivery. Free. Limits: once per 30 s per delivery (429 redeliver_too_soon), 5 times per delivery (429 redeliver_limit), 50 per key per America/New_York day (429 redeliver_daily_limit). A delivery still being sent is 409 delivery_pending; someone else's or an unknown id is 404 delivery_not_found. The same as POST /api/v1/webhooks/deliveries/{id}/redeliver.

api_key.description: Your HorseToga API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

delivery_id.description: A delivery's id from list_webhook_deliveries (or a job's webhook.delivery_id).
